theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_atg_approxTangent_le_of_flat
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (Q T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < r → μHE[n] ((A ∩ ball x r) \ S) = 0 → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ y ∈ S, dist y x < ρ → ∃ t ∈ T, ‖y - x - t‖ ≤ ε * ‖y - x‖) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → Q ≤ T
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
